Jurors stake 19% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 257 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
